name: gpu-panel
description: A panel under the prompt for shared GPU servers: which cards are busy and who is on them, your running training jobs, plan limits and context, with effort/model/compact buttons.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the usage toast, the /gpu description and the pane's empty states. The panel's own labels (5h, ctx, gpu) stay as they are.

palette.title: Color palette
palette.description: dark: fixed colors tuned for a dark terminal. theme: follow the Claude Code theme, for light terminals.

fiveHourThreshold.title: 5-hour usage warning (%)
fiveHourThreshold.description: Show a toast once per window when 5-hour plan usage reaches this percentage.

sevenDayThreshold.title: 7-day usage warning (%)
sevenDayThreshold.description: Show a toast once per window when 7-day plan usage reaches this percentage.

hideQuietStatus.title: Hide other mods' all-clear status lines
hideQuietStatus.description: Hide status lines from other mods that only say nothing is wrong ("no active cases", "waste≈0"). Warnings always stay. Off by default because it removes another mod's output.
